description: Momentum-continuation short in the weakest configured name, faded into a bounce. APT/USDT is down return7d -11.654974489795912 from close 0.5541 while SOL lost only -2.8472906403940845 over the same window, and today's return1d 1.3165112452002248 is a shallow bounce inside that downtrend rather than a trend change. Positioning gives no squeeze cushion to bears: fundingRate8hAvg3d 0.000006003333333333336 is marginally positive (longs still paying) with fundingRatePercentile90d 35.18518518518518, and oiChange3dPct 1.1493557109280905 shows open interest grinding higher into a falling price — late longs adding, not capitulating. The supply catalyst is the recurring monthly Aptos unlock cadence: ~11.31M APT (~0.65% of circulating supply) released on Sept 11-12, 2026, with the vesting schedule continuing on a monthly cadence thereafter. I hold this at low confidence deliberately: spec evidence rates unlock-driven declines as weak and plausibly pre-priced by participants reading the same public schedule, and the Confidential APT mainnet launch on Sept 8, 2026 is a genuine offsetting positive. This is a relative-weakness trade with an unlock overlay, not an unlock-timing trade. Stop must respect realizedVol7d 77.94764652251865 and atr14d 0.04397142857142859 (~7.9% of spot per ATR).
